headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 17, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 26.04%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark's return of 14.27%. This results in an average alpha of 11.77%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 47.42%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', still maintains a respectable return of 19.05%. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's strategy. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
